name: Chicken, Bell Pepper & Goat Cheese Panini with Arugula Tomato Salad

cookwares.name: grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a grill pan or skillet over medium-high heat.
Slice chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
0.681 kg boneless skinless chicken breasts
⅜ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Coat grill/skillet with oil. Add chicken and cook until cooked through, 2-3 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate.
Wash, seed, and cut bell peppers into short strips.
Return grill/skillet to stove. Add peppers and cook until tender-crisp, 3-4 minutes. Transfer to plate with chicken.
Peel and mince garlic. In a small bowl, prepare the spread by mashing together garlic, goat cheese, vinegar, and oregano.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
1 ½ (113 g) log goat cheese
1 ½ tsp balsamic vinegar
1 ½ tsp oregano

instructions.primary_message: Spread the goat cheese mixture onto each of the bun/roll halves. Top bottom halves with a few arugula leaves, chicken, and ½ of the bell peppers (save the rest for the salad). Close with top halves.

Place sandwiches on grill/skillet and carefully flatten using a panini press or something heavy. Cook until browned and crispy on the bottom, 1-2 minutes. Carefully flip and continue cooking until browned on the other side, another 1-2 minutes.
In a large bowl, prepare salad dressing by whisking together oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
4 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tbsp balsamic vinegar
3 pinches salt
3 pinches black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry arugula and tomatoes. Cut the tomatoes into thin wedges. Add arugula, tomatoes, and remaining bell pepper to bowl with dressing. Toss salad.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (142 g) pkg baby arugula
3 tomatoes

instructions.primary_message: To serve, cut panini in half and place on a plate with salad on the side. Enjoy!
